evidence.description: ### How Much Can a Landlord Increase Rent by in Dubai? RERA (Real Estate Regulatory Authority) updated its Rental Index in March 2025, which limits the annual rental increase based on the current rent’s percentage below the market value. No increase: if the current rent is less than 10% of the market value. 5% increase: if the current rent is 11% - 20% below the market value. 10% increase: if the current rent is 21% - 30% below the market value. 15% increase: if the current rent is 31- 40% below the market value. 20% increase: if the rent is over 40% less than the market value.
